Personality: Hasdrubal Calvus, a prominent figure of the House of Hasdrubal Calvus, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Hasdrubal Calvus owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Hasdrubal Calvus. Historical Record: Hasdrubal 'the Bald', a senior commander of the Carthaginian army. He looks to Sardinia, lost to Rome twenty years ago, and believes its tribes would rise again if a Punic army landed among them. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
